title: Shoes You Can Step Into
summary: Get comfortable shoes you can step into—our slip-ons for men and women are made from renewable materials and will take you through your whole day in comfort.
body_markdown:
# Shoes you can step into


You can step into the unknown or step into the spotlight. Luckily, Allbirds has something for these moments, with shoes you can step into in lightweight, flexible styles.


## Step into our Slip-on Shoes


When you need to leave the house in a rush (or when you’re just over tying up laces), the easy answer is some stylish slip-on shoes. With a handy pull tab for pulling them on quickly, you can be out the door and into your day. Here are our slip-ons for everyday wear:


### Tree Loungers Made with Eucalyptus Fiber


[Women’s Tree Loungers](https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-tree-loungers) are our lightweight, slip-on-and-go sneakers. These are easy to get on and off, but easy to wear all day as well, whether out on errands or wearing around the house as your[designated indoor shoes](https://www.allbirds.com/pages/best-shoes-for-being-indoors) .


Made with renewable materials like eucalyptus tree fiber and sugarcane-based green EVA, you can enjoy your walk, your sightseeing, or your farmer’s market knowing that your choices are good for our planet. (Our Tree Lounger has a carbon footprint of 4.11 kg CO2e. Learn more about[carbon footprint labeling](https://www.allbirds.com/pages/footprint) and[our commitments to reduce our impact](https://www.allbirds.com/pages/sustainable-practices) .)


Available in[Men’s styles](https://www.allbirds.com/products/mens-tree-loungers) and[Women’s styles](https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-tree-loungers) .


### Wool Loungers Made with Soft Merino Wool


Yep, they’re as comfortable as they look. These slip-on sneakers are made with soft ZQ Merino wool and will last through all of the dog walks, park walks, or nature walks you can put them through.


The cushioned midsole makes these great for everyday use and all-day wear. They’re cozy for days that are on the chilly side or for[travels to someplace cold](https://www.allbirds.com/pages/what-shoes-to-wear-when-traveling-someplace-cold) , especially when you need to be on your feet a lot being a proper tourist. Plus, our Wool Lounger has a carbon footprint of 6.68 kg CO2e. (Learn more about[carbon footprint labeling](https://www.allbirds.com/pages/footprint) and[our commitments to reduce our impact](https://www.allbirds.com/pages/sustainable-practices) .)


Want a shoe without a back? The[Wool Lounger Mules](https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-wool-lounger-mule) combines a cozy merino wool construction with a sleek, backless slip-on design that's perfect for relaxing at home, running quick errands, or adding effortless style to your day.


Available in[Men’s styles](https://www.allbirds.com/products/mens-wool-loungers) and[Women’s styles](https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-wool-loungers) .


### Tree Dasher Relay: the Slip-on Active Shoe


Who’s up for dashing? And relays? If your active life feels like a high-school track meet and you’re as busy as ever on your feet, treat yourself to the Tree Dasher Relay. Rated as a top walking shoe for active people, this slip-on has a one-piece upper without a bunch of seams so it’s less likely to cause irritation.


The rim has a nice feature: a lightly padded heel collar that keeps the shoe from sliding around. And the cushioned midsole makes every step smoother and every part of your day feel a little bit more do-able.


Available in[Men’s styles](https://www.allbirds.com/products/mens-tree-dasher-relay) and[Women’s styles](https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-tree-dasher-relay) .
